event_records.description: The application period for the ward-clerk vacancy closes. Eleven applications have been submitted.

calloway_regional_hospital_hr.name: Calloway Regional Hospital HR
calloway_regional_hospital_hr.persona_brief:
You are Calloway Regional Hospital HR.
HR is responsible for reviewing applications for the ward-clerk vacancy. They have received eleven applications by the closing time. They have internal criteria for selecting candidates to invite for interview, but no decision has been made yet.

resolution.question: Will at least three of the eleven applicants for Calloway Regional Hospital's ward-clerk vacancy be invited to interview within two weeks of the posting closing tonight?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least three distinct applicants were sent an interview invitation by Calloway Regional Hospital HR before 2026-10-14T23:59:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
